newsitem.title: FRANCE: Aide to Saddam Hussein treated in France - ministry.
newsitem.headline: Aide to Saddam Hussein treated in France - ministry.

text.p: France has allowed a military aide to Iraqi President Saddam Hussein to undergo hospital treatment in Paris for heart trouble, the French Foreign Ministry said on Thursday.

"The French authorities, at the request of Iraqi authorities and for humanitarian reasons, have authorised the hospitalisation of Rokan Abdul Ghaffour, a military aide assigned to the Iraqi presidency," ministry spokesman Jacques Rummelhard said.
He gave no details of his condition but said the sanctions committee enforcing a six-year U.N. trade embargo had approved his trip to France.

France has been pressing for a limited easing of the economic stranglehold on Iraq, imposed through U.N. resolutions which call for Iraq's partial disarmament, recognition of Kuwait and compensation for Gulf War damage.
